title: Close out Phase 1: retro + plan Phase 2
description: Retro on the Phase 1 run, fold learnings into .tick/learnings.md within the 150-line cap, verify the epic outside-in against a live cloud run, then plan the Phase 2 epic (1vn, cloud substrate fan-out) against what the single-sandbox run actually taught.
notes: 2026-08-19 21:47 - When planning Phase 2 (1vn) during this closeout, you MUST create the sandbox benchmarking tick — the human asked for it explicitly on 2026-08-19 and the full brief is recorded on 1vn (cold/warm/hot start, per-stage breakdown, fan-out at N=1/3/5, cost per run, and the three assumptions the numbers are meant to settle).
